scope: Executor-signed portable receipt binding an A4 signed handoff proposal, an A1 executor identity credential and an independently Grid-signed terminal machine-intent receipt. No effect-specific receipt or task-success claim is created.
core_invariant: A portable receipt may prove that an identified executor packaged a verified Grid terminal lifecycle record for the exact handoff. A terminal completed state is not by itself proof of application correctness, truth, concrete effect execution, artifact availability or task success.

risks: different A1 credential used after handoff
same executor name rebound to a different credential
wrong operational key signs portable receipt
controls: A4 intended-executor identity digest must equal exact A1 credential digest
executor principal ID must equal A4 intended executor ID
portable receipt signature key must equal A1 operational key ID
exact Grid machine receipt digest bound into portable statement
terminal fields reproduced from supplied Grid receipt
Grid input digest equals A4 input digest
Grid intent principal equals executor A1 principal
Grid machine-authority digest equals executor A1 principal-authority digest

risks: completion after expiry misclassified as invalid even though admission was timely
controls: Grid intent created_at must fall inside signed A4 proposal window
Grid finished_at may follow proposal expiry
timestamps are materialized Grid evidence, not trusted wall-clock proof

risks: completed lifecycle state marketed as task success
completed echo/process treated as application correctness
Grid terminal receipt treated as consume-before-effect proof
real filesystem/process/network effect inferred without effect receipt
controls: A5b separately required to bind independently verified effect-specific executor receipts

risks: reported artifact digest interpreted as available artifact
reported evidence digest interpreted as independently verified evidence
controls: reported_artifact_digests and reported_evidence_digests are signed reports only
supplied fixed semantics validated before normalization
executor signature and receipt digest bind exact statement

risks: Grid terminal receipt belongs to another machine-authority definition
executor credential reissued with different authority but same principal name
controls: Grid machine_authority_digest must equal exact A1 executor principal_authority_digest
A4 target binds exact executor credential digest

risks: historical receipt replayed as current authority
portable receipt used to re-execute work

known_nonclaims: A5a does not prove concrete effect execution beyond the verified Grid terminal lifecycle record.
A5a does not claim task success, application correctness or truth.
A5a does not verify availability of reported artifacts or independently verify reported evidence digests.
A5a does not establish global identity, authority or revocation currentness.
A5a does not authorize replay, retry, delegation or execution.
A5a does not replace effect-specific receipts such as consume-before-effect executor evidence.
A5a does not modify capability-registry state or a supported effect path.
next_gates: A5b bind and independently verify concrete effect-specific executor receipts such as the #1137 read-system-facts receipt
A6 bind current identity/delegation/revocation evidence consulted at effect admission
A10 independent verifier package for A1/A2/A4/A5 artifact chains
cross-protocol parity tests preserving the same receipt semantics
